subject: Decision lanes & procurement playbook — Ava Solutions next steps
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@avasolutions.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2027 16:12:00 -0000
Subject: Decision lanes & procurement playbook — Ava Solutions next steps

Hi Maria —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery and the concrete asks we discussed so we have alignment across teams: 

1) Who signs: we need the economic buyer + legal sign-off owner so we can scope contract length and SLA tiers.
2) Security review: who will own the questionnaire and evidence uploads (SOC2 artifacts, data flow diagrams).
3) Procurement flow: PO vs contract + any budget cycle windows we should know about.
4) Technical kickoff: identify an integration owner for an initial 2-hour workshop.

Can you share a simple org chart (even a screenshot) showing the three groups above (Business Sponsor / Procurement / Security) and the names/emails for the people you recommend we loop in? If there are internal approval gates or a procurement intake URL, send that too.

I attached a one-page meeting summary and a sample security questionnaire we typically use as a starting point. Proposed next steps:
- You share org chart + procurement contact by EOD Thu 11/12
- We schedule the 2-hour workshop week of 11/22 once we have the procurement window

If easier, we can run a quick 20-min alignment call to map decision lanes — happy to include Ben (commercial lead) and Laura (legal ops).

Best,
Sergio
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-discovery-summary.pdf]
[Attachment: security-questionnaire-template.xlsx]

From: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@avasolutions.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Harris <tom.harris@avasolutions.com>, Procurement Team <procure@avasolutions.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2027 09:04:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Decision lanes & procurement playbook — Ava Solutions next steps

Hi Sergio —

Thanks for the clear recap. Attaching a lightweight org diagram and our small procurement intake checklist. Highlights:

- Economic buyer: Tom Harris (VP Product) — primary sign-off for subscription value and ROI questions.
- Legal owner: Kate Munroe (Legal Ops) — will handle contract redlines and IP clauses.
- Security reviewer: Raj Patel (InfoSec) — owns questionnaire and evidence requests.
- Procurement: procure@avasolutions.com handles POs and standard SLAs; we are on a monthly budget cycle.

Notes: we already routed a conservative budget for a pilot this quarter but procurement needs estimated monthly burn and a sample SOW to approve PO processing.

Attaching: avasolutions-org-chart.png and procure-intake.pdf

Best,
Maria
Head of Platform Partnerships, Ava Solutions
[Attachment: avasolutions-org-chart.png]
[Attachment: procure-intake.pdf]

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@avasolutions.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2027 10:22:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Decision lanes & procurement playbook — Ava Solutions next steps

Appreciate this, Maria — this is super helpful. Two quick follow-ups:

1) Procurement asks: can you confirm whether procurement needs an executed NDA before they share PII/data-scope artifacts? If so, we'll get that back to you today.
2) Security evidence: Raj — would you prefer we upload documents to a secure SFTP link or share a Drive folder with restricted access? We can do either; we have a short list of artifacts (SOC2 report, architecture diagram, data retention policy).

Ben — recommend we prep a 1-page estimated monthly cost + pilot SOW draft and send to procure@avasolutions.com. Marissa — can you draft the SOW & cost snapshot and drop it in the shared Drive link below?

Proposed shared location: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AvaKickoff

Thanks,
Sergio
[Attachment: Ava_NDA_draft_for_signature.pdf]

From: Tom Harris <tom.harris@avasolutions.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@avasolutions.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@avasolutions.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@avasolutions.com>, Kate Munroe <kate.munroe@avasolutions.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2027 14:30:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Decision lanes & procurement playbook — Ava Solutions next steps

Sergio / Maria —

Quick note from my side: happy to be the economic buyer for a pilot. A few decision criteria I care about:
- Predictable per-token pricing and burst controls
- Ability to run in a private VPC for sensitive workloads
- Clear escalation SLA for inference outages affecting customer-facing flows

Raj — we prefer Drive links with restricted access for evidence. Procurement will need the SOW + an estimated month 1 run-rate by EOD Wed 11/18 to move the PO. Kate — legal will review a single redline pass; if you can provide a one-pager that calls out any non-standard clauses, that will speed review.

Tom
VP Product, Ava Solutions

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@avasolutions.com>, Tom Harris <tom.harris@avasolutions.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Nov 2027 09:03:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Decision lanes & procurement playbook — Ava Solutions next steps

Morning all —

Thanks for confirming, Tom — great to have an economic buyer identified. Action items from our side and owners: 

- Marissa: upload pilot SOW + estimated month-1 run-rate to Drive by EOD Wed 11/18 (will include line items for dedicated vs hosted).
- Ben: follow up with procurement on PO process and expected lead time; cc Tom.
- Laura: prepare a single-page summary of contract redlines and any non-standard clauses to accelerate Kate's review.
- Sergio: schedule a 90–120 minute technical workshop for week of 11/22; will include Raj + integration owner.

We have the following attachments ready: Ava_NDA_signed.pdf (returned), security-questionnaire-template.xlsx (for Raj). I'll drop the SOW link into the Drive folder and ping everyone when done.

If there's anything else you need to unblock procurement, tell me now and i'll include it in the packet.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Ava_NDA_signed.pdf]
[Attachment: security-questionnaire-template.xlsx]
